agent_summary:
Lane 58 (Configuration, WSTG-CONF-01..11) worked against juice.lab.test, an OWASP Juice Shop (Node/Express + Angular SPA) behind nginx/1.30.5. HTTPS/443 refused; only HTTP/80 answers. The host uses a catch-all that returns the SPA index (200) for unknown paths, so bodies were compared, not status codes.

Done: 01 network infra (nginx/1.30.5 banner, no TLS). 02 platform (Express ^4.22.1 verbose stack traces leaking server paths; unauth application-configuration JSON). 03 file extensions (direct .bak blocked by "only .md/.pdf" filter, bypassed with poison null byte /ftp/..%2500.md to retrieve backup contents). 04 backup/unreferenced files (/ftp directory listing exposes *.bak, incident-support.kdbx, etc.; /.git/HEAD and /.env absent). 05 admin interfaces (unauth /metrics Prometheus endpoint and /rest/admin/application-configuration). 06 HTTP methods (OPTIONS advertises GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE with ACAO:*). 07 HSTS (HTTP-only, no Strict-Transport-Security header). 08 RIA cross-domain (no crossdomain.xml/clientaccesspolicy.xml — catch-all index only). 09 file permissions (world-readable /ftp serving sensitive files; OS-level perms not inspectable over HTTP). 11 cloud storage (config references only local assets, no S3/GCS/Azure buckets found).

N/A: 10 subdomain takeover — single in-scope host, no subdomains/dangling CNAMEs in scope and DNS resolution not possible with read-only HTTP.

Leads recorded: exposed /ftp with null-byte extension-filter bypass (medium); unauth /metrics (low); verbose Express stack traces (low); unauth admin application-configuration (low). All testing was read-only; no writes proposed (engagement is read-only).

leads.title: [agent] Exposed /ftp directory listing with backup and sensitive files + null-byte extension bypass

detail.text: GET http://juice.lab.test/ftp returns a directory listing of leftover/sensitive files (package.json.bak, package-lock.json.bak, coupons_2013.md.bak, incident-support.kdbx, encrypt.pyc, suspicious_errors.yml, announcement_encrypted.md). An extension filter blocks non-.md/.pdf downloads, but the poison null-byte path /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.md bypasses it and returns the backup file contents. Allows retrieval of files intended to be blocked.

GET http://juice.lab.test/metrics returns 200 with full Prometheus metrics (process CPU/memory, open FDs, event-loop lag, HTTP status counters, app startup timings) with no authentication. Discloses internal runtime/infra details.

GET http://juice.lab.test/rest/admin/application-configuration returns the full application configuration JSON (server settings, OAuth client IDs, contact emails, feature flags) without authentication.
